test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Acts legally guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to adult members of a rural household who seek employment and are willing to do unskilled manual work?

options.text: Indira National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Nehru National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Ambedkar National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is** Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A rural wage employment scheme called **MGNREGA** was launched in India in 2005.
 
• **The Ministry of Rural Development (MRD)**, which oversees the full implementation of this **programme with state governments**, keeps an eye on it.
 
• By creating chances for** wage employment**, it helps the impoverished in rural areas improve the security of their means of subsistence.
 
• Additionally, it strives to build a rural asset base that would improve productive job opportunities and increase and sustain a rural household's income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adult members of rural households** now have the legal right to employment due to the Act. At least one-third of the recipients must be women.
 
• It promotes the empowerment of disadvantaged groups. The largest social security programme in the world is **MGNREGA**.
 
• It functions as a plan to fight poverty. It was a tool that many utilised to escape poverty.
 
• Also, it contributes to the creation of jobs and financial inclusion of individuals.
 
• It also gave the** rural economy a boost.**
